acceptance_criteria: A camera switch in the gesture view (vorne/hinten, symbol and words, at least --tile-min high) is stored on the device under its own key, default front, independent of teaching's camera choice; switching while the camera runs restarts the attempt with the other camera and records nothing; a press within the press guard does nothing
A back camera that does not open shows the problem line and the switch stays, so the front camera can be chosen again

In the gesture view no video element is shown: only the tracked hands with L/R and the shoulders on a calm background, mirrored for the front camera only; teaching and the camera test keep their video
Every state of the view fits 320x480 to 820x1180 without page scroll

goal: In the gesture view the person holding the device can switch between front and back camera, and the view shows the detected hands without the camera picture.
